# ctxlint

> Token budget linter for prompt and context files. Agent-first: JSON out, zero config.

## Install
npx -y ctxlint --json

## MCP
npx -y -p ctxlint@latest ctxlint-mcp

## Docs
- README.md: usage, config, exit codes
- AGENTS.md: agent instructions
- schema/report.schema.json: output contract
- action.yml: GitHub Action

## Facts
- Runs offline
- No API key required
- No telemetry
- Exit 0 clean, 1 breach, 2 error
- Counts approximate, gpt-tokenizer pinned
- Defaults cover CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, prompts/**, .cursor/rules/**
